Wondering what grade 4 looks like? Here's the big picture, in plain words. 📚

Math, reading and writing all get a little deeper this year.
Every school and board sets its own order, so your child's teacher has the details.
There's one easy thing to try at home on the last slide.

What's your child's favourite subject this year?

slides.sub: The big ideas, in plain words

slides.title: Numbers get bigger and smarter
items: They are linked. Think equal groups and fair sharing.
Equal parts of a whole, like pizza slices.
Place value: what each digit is worth.
slides.example: Example: Maya cuts a pizza into 8 equal slices and eats 3. That's 3 out of 8.

slides.title: Reading for meaning
items: What is this mostly about? Which details prove it?
What the author hints at but doesn't say.
slides.example: Example: "Why do you think Leo looked away?" is a great question for any story.

slides.title: Writing gets organised
items: An opening line, a few details, a closing line.

slides.title: Tiny ways to help at home
items: Ask: how can we split this equally?
Read a page, then ask why
Why did the character do that?
Favourite dinner? Say it and give a reason.
